author: Andrew Fisher
assessment: No remaining demonstrated blocker in bounded independent CPU/source review of final candidate. Two reproduced readiness/recovery findings were corrected by the source owner.

validation.note: Per requested bounded rerun, the original 42-check suite is bound to the earlier candidate. Final source matches exactly the seven reviewed follow-up replacements, covered by eight affected-delta checks. No claim that all 42 fixtures were rerun on final bytes.

resolved_finding.name: Parent readiness survived terminal child context loss

demonstration.author: Andrew Fisher
demonstration.limitation: CPU exact helper/readiness callback only; no browser, GPU, network or live session.

resolved_finding.correction: Child failure clears __ready and notifies the parent; parent failure handoff clears ready3d and outstanding polls, ready callback rejects __bootError, and sync3d gates on public API state.ready.
resolved_finding.status: Resolved and regression-tested on corrected candidate

scoped_conclusions: No application-level automatic 3D root request or iframe reload was introduced; Retry requires the button press. Cesium internals are not simulated.
The exact key function aborts at 20,000 ms, cleans its timer on success/error, and does not retry HTTP/JSON failures automatically.
Slow startup keeps the one pending imagery request; late success clears its warning. Context loss prevents late imagery from restarting a scene.
Readiness polls are owned by a load epoch, a late healthy callback can recover from the slow state, and 2D/3D switches reuse the frame and stop camera motion.
Native compass/orbit cancellation and flight takeover pass; Ground and Street use the unchanged SITE_H=44.6 datum plus 12 m and 45 m respectively. Other camera presets remain unchanged.
Patch replay on exact live inputs reproduces both candidate files byte-for-byte, second application is refused, and changed POC baseline is refused.
limits: No product files edited; no browser, GPU, network or service requests made by this independent review.

Parser-blocking external Cesium script at poc3d/index.html:84 executes before runtime recovery code; an indefinitely pending library transfer is not bounded by the runtime 30-second warning. Existing limitation, not a new regression.
SOURCE SITE_H is the existing datum, not an independently surveyed elevation or visual proof of clearance.
Google billing, Cesium internal retries, physical-device performance, visual layout and actual WebGL restoration require separate evidence.

resolved_render_finding.name: Late imagery cleared a terminal render error while loop stayed disabled
resolved_render_finding.correction: Terminal failure kind is retained separately from the nonterminal slow warning. A late tileset is destroyed and boot returns; a later imagery rejection preserves the original terminal failure kind. Cesium built-in render-error panel is disabled and scene.renderError uses the same manual recovery UI.
